messages:
oncall-bot: PAGER: P1 increased 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate (us-west-2-dedicated) — spike started ~5m ago. Alerting on 5xx_ratio > 5% over 3m.

alex_sre: On it. I'm taking the page. Starting triage: checking hosts and LB.

ellie_infra: I see connection reset errors from our GPU hosts to GCP internal endpoints 10.128.x.x — TLS handshake failures and ECONNRESET across multiple AZs. Aggregating logs now.

raj_platform: Can you paste the kubernetes pod errors? I want to see if this is app-level or network.

ellie_infra: logs snippet:
```
kubelet: networkPlugin cni failed: failed to set up network for pod \"...\": rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing
nginx: 502 upstream connect error or connection reset by peer while reading response header from upstream
```

alex_sre: Looks like upstream (host->provider) connectivity. Looks correlated with cloud LB healthchecks failing. Putting incident into P1. Paging cloud account rep.

alex_sre: @cloud-account-rep can you confirm if there's any known maintenance or incidents in us-west-2 affecting connectivity? We need escalation path.

cloud-account-rep: Thanks for the ping — I'm seeing increased packet drops on a subset of our fabric in us-west-2. Opening an internal escalation with networking. Sharing case ID: GCP-31255. Will update in 10m.

linda_support: Heads-up from support: two enterprise customers reported degraded embeddings and generation latency to >10s and some 5xx replies. They're asking for ETA/status.

maria_pm: We should prepare an initial status page update and a short customer email. Drafting now — will post for review.

alex_sre: Mitigation plan options: 1) Route traffic to another region (us-east-1) via routing policy (fast but will increase latency and cost), 2) Failover to hosted pool (if tenants allow migration), 3) Temporary autoscale more capacity to mask errors (unlikely if root cause is provider network). I want to test region routing for a small canary first.

raj_platform: I can flip a weight to route 5% of traffic to us-east-1 for non-sensitive customers. Will prepare a canary config.

ellie_infra: Also enabling extra TCP keepalive and increasing retry policy in the proxy as short-term workaround. Pushing change now.

alex_sre: Good. Draft status page (PROPOSED):
"We are investigating elevated 5xx errors for inference requests from customers in the us-west-2 region. Our engineering team is working with our cloud provider to diagnose potential networking instability affecting routing to dedicated capacity. We will provide updates every 15 minutes."

maria_pm: Customer notification (short):
"Hi — we’re investigating increased errors and latency for inference in US‑West. Our team is actively working on a fix and we’ve opened an escalation with our cloud provider. We’ll update you within 30 minutes. If you’re seeing production impact, please reply here and our support team will prioritize."

linda_support: Approved with minor edit: add link to status.redwood.ai/incidents (placeholder) and point to support contact.

alex_sre: I'm going to request provider escalations to get a bridge. cloud-account-rep please share bridge details once available. Also adding ops-lead.

cloud-account-rep: Bridge created: gcp-bridge-usw2-31255. Joining now.

ops-lead: Joining the bridge. Quick ask: collect traceroutes from affected hosts and BGP table snapshots if possible.

ellie_infra: Traceroute from host gpu-uw2-14:
```
traceroute to 10.128.34.1 (10.128.34.1), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.128.34.1  0.52 ms  0.49 ms  0.45 ms
 2  172.217.12.1  1.1 ms  1.0 ms  1.0 ms
 3  * * *
 4  * * *
```

alex_sre: Good. I'm going to update status page now with the draft and link to bridge.

oncall-bot: STATUS PAGE UPDATED: "Investigating — Engineering working with cloud provider" (update_id: 2026-03-15-1).

linda_support: Pushed customer emails to affected accounts list + flagged as high priority. Copy of message posted to CRM case.

maria_pm: For exec/internal update — short template:
"Summary: Elevated 5xx errors affecting us-west-2 Dedicated region impacting generation and embedding quality. Impact: ~X% of requests from west region; Y customers reported. Root cause: suspected cloud provider network instability (under investigation). Next steps: provider bridge open, region canary in progress to route traffic, support proactively notified. ETA: TBD. Will update every 15 min."

alex_sre: Canary start: switching 5% traffic -> us-east-1 for non-enterprise tenants. Command:
```
redwood route set --from us-west-2 --to us-east-1 --percentage 5 --selector \"!enterprise\"
```

raj_platform: Canary applied. Monitoring logs.

ellie_infra: After canary, errors on canary path are green. Main path still showing ~6% 5xx.

alex_sre: That indicates problem localized to us-west-2 path. Continue canary ramp to 25% if stable.

ops-lead: Agree, but ensure we have capacity in us-east-1 and cost approval. Maria — any objections on ramp?

maria_pm: Cost OK for now to protect SLAs. Ramp to 25%.

raj_platform: Ramp to 25% applied.

cloud-account-rep: Networking team identified intermittent fabric microbursts causing packet loss on internal spine switches — they're applying mitigations. They request we keep bridge open; expected mitigation window 30–45 minutes, monitoring required.

linda_support: Customer reply from large enterprise: "Thanks for the update — can you confirm data residency if we route to us-east?"

alex_sre: For enterprise tenants we will not auto-route without permission. We only routed non-enterprise. Reply to customer: "We are routing non-enterprise traffic to an alternate region; enterprise traffic remains pinned to your region — support will work with you on options if you want to opt-in to regional failover."

linda_support: Sent.

oncall-bot: HANDOFF: alex_sre handing off to ellie_infra for next 30m monitoring window. New responder: ellie_infra, previous: alex_sre.

ellie_infra: I'll monitor the bridge and metrics. If provider reports resolved, we'll start rolling back routes and post a resolution message.

ops-lead: One more action: open a formal post-incident vendor RFO request and ask provider for packet captures and internal metrics. cloud-account-rep can you obtain that?

cloud-account-rep: Will request pcap and internal telemetry for the window 18:10–18:40 UTC. Adding to case GCP-31255.

alex_sre: Thx. Drafting final customer follow-up for now:
"Update: We have confirmed networking instability in US‑West. We have mitigated impact by routing a portion of traffic to an alternative region; enterprise customers remain pinned. Our provider has applied mitigations and we are monitoring. Next update in 15 minutes or when the provider confirms resolution. Case: GCP-31255. "

maria_pm: Good. Please include an action item that we will publish a full postmortem once vendor RFO is available.

ellie_infra: Provider just posted: "We’ve applied a fix targeting the fabric microbursts. Observability shows error rates dropping. Continue monitoring."

raj_platform: Metrics trending down. 5xx rate now 0.8% in main path. Canary path stable.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT SEVERITY: reduced to P2 based on lowered error rates.

ellie_infra: I'll keep the bridge open for 30 more minutes, then close if stable. Preparing rollback plan: revert routing to 100% us-west-2 and revert proxy retry changes.

linda_support: Support notified customers of the mitigation and next steps. No escalations open at the moment.

ops-lead: Great work. Post-incident to-dos: 1) postmortem + timeline, 2) vendor RFO and packet captures, 3) review routing runbook for faster cross-region failover, 4) update status page with resolution once fully closed.

cloud-account-rep: I’ll attach pcaps and fabric metrics to the case and coordinate the RFO.

ellie_infra: Closing notes: plan to roll back canary at +30m if no regressions. If anyone sees resurge, @ellie_infra oncall.

alex_sre: Thanks all — major props to support and cloud rep for quick bridge.

oncall-bot: THREAD CLOSED (automated) — incident moved to monitoring.
